1. (Currently amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __other than creating the path or displacing tissue__.

2. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a therapeutic function beyond channel creation__.

3. (Original): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the working channel in place__.

7. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __with a structural support element__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __other than tissue displacement or channel creation__.

8. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a therapeutic function beyond channel creation__.

9. (Original): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while maintaining the working channel in place__.

12. (Original): The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.

13. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __other than channel creation or tissue displacement__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __while maintaining the working channel in place__.

14. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a therapeutic function beyond channel creation__.

15. (Original): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Original): The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
